title: Intel CEO Reportedly Echoes Nvidia’s Jensen Huang On Lower-Cost Chinese AI Models – Traders Watch $100 Level
key_facts: Lip-Bu Tan, Intel chief executive, reportedly spoke on Monday 12 October.
He said Chinese frontier AI models cost less per token and adoption has been 'very fast'.
He called the performance of DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM 'good enough'.
He said 'I'm a strong believer of open source; that's the best way to drive efficiency'.
Jensen Huang said in July that DeepSeek, Alibaba and Moonshot AI models were 'excellent'.
Intel shares fell as much as 1.6% pre-market; Intel's data center and AI revenue rose 59% in the second quarter.
quote_evidence: According to Reuters, he called the performance of models like DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM "good enough."
"I'm a strong believer of open source; that's the best way to drive efficiency," and said markets will decide which models suit which use cases.
why_it_matters_hint: Another chip company chief executive backs low-cost Chinese open models.
notes: Reuters original not read; Stocktwits relays it. Date taken from 'on Monday' in a report published 15 Oct 00:30 UTC.
